dimensions.name: consistency
dimensions.criteria: 章内设定、人称、时间线与既定事实一致

dimensions.name: character
dimensions.criteria: 角色言行符合设定档案并体现明确动机

dimensions.name: pacing
dimensions.criteria: 节奏张弛有度，场景推进自然不拖沓

dimensions.name: continuity
dimensions.criteria: 与大纲、前文伏笔及章节摘要保持连续

dimensions.name: foreshadow
dimensions.criteria: 合理埋设伏笔并为后续章节提供牵引

dimensions.name: hook
dimensions.criteria: 章末留有悬念或牵引力

dimensions.name: aesthetic
dimensions.criteria: 语言质量、句式多样性与文风统一
